name: updateTableLinkLabels
description: Updates column labels for a table link. Corresponds to PUT /tableLinks/{tableLinkId}. Requires `tables:write` scope. [WRITE]

tableLinkId.description: ID of the table link to update

leftColumnLabel.description: Label of the link column in the left table. Both labels are required; resend the current label for the side you are not changing.

rightColumnLabel.description: Label of the link column in the right table.
